## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits and the branch name follows the naming rules
- [ ] The branch is rebased on the latest `main` and has no conflicts
- [ ] `scripts/precheck.sh --full` passes (branch, commits, SwiftLint, build and tests)
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for changed behaviour
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when behaviour or user-facing options change
- [ ] No private APIs, screen capture, input monitoring, new permissions or personal data
